note: Start-up regression gate for `node scripts/timing.mjs --gate timing-baseline.json` (hook-timing workflow, shipped bundle). Measure: warm pre-allow p95 divided by bare `node -e ""` p50 on the same runner. Fails when that ratio is more than `tolerance` above the baseline in three measurements in a row. Lower the ratios when start-up improves; never raise them to make CI pass. Baselines (2026-11-27): medians of the bundle runs on GitHub's runners, 23 on ubuntu-latest and 24 on windows-latest.
